name: Purella GRAVITY
summary: Purella Gravity UF Water Purifier is a non-electric, gravity-based water purifier featuring a 20-litre storage capacity , advanced 3-stage UF filtration , and chemical-free purification.
intro: The Purella Gravity UF Water Purifier is a reliable, non-electric water purification system designed to provide safe and healthy drinking water without the use of electricity or chemicals. Operating on the natural principle of gravity, it offers an economical and eco-friendly solution for homes, offices, hostels, rural areas, and outdoor activities such as camping or road trips.
features: Non-Electric Gravity-Based Purification – Operates without electricity, making it ideal for areas with frequent power cuts.
Advanced 3-Stage Filtration – Combines sediment filtration, activated carbon, and UF membrane technology for effective purification.
Ultra Filtration (UF) Technology – Removes bacteria, cysts, parasites, and other harmful microorganisms while retaining essential minerals.
20-Litre Storage Capacity – Large capacity with 11L upper chamber and 9L lower chamber for uninterrupted access to purified water.
4 Litres Per Hour Filtration Rate – Provides a steady supply of purified water for daily household needs.
Long Filter Life – Purifies up to 1,800 litres before filter replacement under standard operating conditions.
Chemical-Free Purification – Delivers safe drinking water without chlorine, iodine, bromine, or other harmful chemicals.

rows: Municipal Tap Water / Low TDS Water
